remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x0A00)
spec2def(qwave.dll qwave.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# qwave.dll is all Rust (qwave-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/qwave-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/qwave-rust/src/qwave/main.rs)
add_cargo_module(qwave qwave-cargo qwave.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE qwave-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk)
add_dependencies(qwave psdk)
